gloss: buying up; hoarding; cornering the supply

definitions.gloss: buying up; panic hoarding; cornering the supply
definitions.explanation: Buying all or most of an available stock, either by consumers stripping the shelves in a shortage or by a buyer cornering a market for profit. The noun form of {買|か}い{占|し}める.

examples.japanese: ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{占|し}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Panic buying of masks broke out.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{占|し}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{張|は}り{紙|がみ}→張り紙：15340_harigami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a notice asking customers to refrain from bulk-buying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品薄|しなうす}→品薄：30618_shinausu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{買|か}い{占|し}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}き→招く：02425_maneku⟧、かえって⟦{品不足|しなぶそく}→品不足：30636_shinabusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Reports of short supply triggered hoarding, which only made the shortage worse.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買|か}い{占|し}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: for hoarding to break out
- {買|か}い{占|し}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent hoarding
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{占|し}め: buying up land
- ⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{占|し}め: buying up for resale

USAGE:
The word carries clear disapproval: the buyer is taking more than their share or manipulating supply. Ordinary bulk shopping is ⟦まとめ{買|が}い→まとめ買い：08046_matomegai⟧, which is neutral and even thrifty.
